messages:
Ava: Quick design review — small-card sparklines in Console. Main items: 1) smoothing toggle default? 2) outlier treatment (clamp vs highlight single dot) 3) compact legend/units for tiny cards 4) aria label copy. Screenshot + prototype in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/sparklines 
Sam: Agree. For tiny sparklines (24px height) smoothing can hide spikes we actually want to surface. I'd default to NO smoothing for those, but offer a persistent per-dashboard toggle. :thinking_face:
Jordan: If we default off, can we show an inline micro-legend with last value + delta? e.g. "12ms ↑3%" — saves space vs full legend. Also consider showing p50/p95 on hover only.
Priya: Accessibility: need aria-labels that summarize latest value and trend. Example: `aria-label="Last 12 ms, increased 3% over previous window"`. Also ensure color contrast for positive/negative deltas.
Ava: Love that aria example. For outliers — proposal: clamp values for visualization scale but add a highlighted outlier marker (single red dot) with a tooltip explaining value. That keeps y-axis stable but doesn't hide extremes. Thoughts?
Sam: Implementation note: adding markers increases draw calls. For many tiny cards it may matter. We can batch render markers when present. Also prefer drawing outlier markers only if value > mean + 3*sigma (configurable).
Jordan: For copy on the smoothing toggle, what about: `Smoothing (ema, window=5)` or simpler `Smoothing — smooth short-term noise`? Short label is better in tight UI.
Priya: Keyboard/voice access: toggle must be focusable and have `aria-pressed` state. Also a longform description available via `aria-describedby` linking to a hidden hint: "Smoothing averages nearby points to reduce noise".
Ava: Proposed tooltip text for outlier dot: `Outlier: 320 ms (10x median). Click for raw series.` Short and actionable.
Sam: Example config snippet for the render pipeline I'd propose:
```
{
  smoothing: { enabled: false, method: 'ema', window: 5 },
  outlier: { mode: 'clamp-with-marker', zscore_threshold: 3 },
  tooltip: { show_p50_p95_on_hover: true }
}
```
Jordan: Layout nit — when we collapse cards to a 3-column compact view, remove micro-legend and surface only last value with trend arrow. Expand on hover to show full sparkline + p95.
deploy-bot: Mockups uploaded to Figma version 17. Please review. :rocket:
Ava: Action items: (1) Sam to prototype marker rendering perf (2) Priya to draft aria copy + hidden hint (3) Jordan to update micro-legend copy (4) I'll update Figma with clamp+marker variant. Back in 48h for sync. :thumbsup:
